outcome: percentage body-weight loss from birth to peak weight loss (%/day)
percentage body-weight gain from peak weight loss to day 4 (%/day)
cohort: The study included 10,544 non-low birth weight and 681 low birth weight neonates who were placed in thermo-controlled incubators for up to 24 hours after birth and received standardized feeding.
finding: While overall growth curves showed a uniform J-shape and body-weight loss patterns did not differ between groups, low birth weight neonates demonstrated significantly faster percentage body-weight gain compared to non-low birth weight neonates under thermal control and nutrition regulation.
birth_weight: Low birth weight (<2500 g) and non-low birth weight (>=2500 g)
